tips.title: Water Saving Tips
tips.subtitle: Simple and effective ways to conserve water at home. Start with easy tips and gradually implement more advanced techniques.

fixLeaks.title: Fix Leaky Faucets
fixLeaks.description: A single dripping faucet can waste over 11,000 liters per year. Check and repair all leaks promptly.

shorterShowers.title: Take Shorter Showers
shorterShowers.description: Reduce shower time by just 2 minutes to save up to 570 liters per month.

lowFlowFixtures.title: Install Low-Flow Fixtures
lowFlowFixtures.description: Replace old showerheads and faucets with water-efficient models.

dishwasher.title: Run Full Dishwasher Loads

garden.title: Water Garden Efficiently

laundry.title: Use Washing Machine Wisely
laundry.description: Wash full loads and use cold water when possible to save both water and energy.
